backend.driver: Apple OS-bundled Metal driver; no separate driver revision queried

scope: Static HDR EXRs. No game/phone extrapolation. Whole command GPU time; no debug/display/readback. Z LUT versus UE analytic changes curve behavior as well as execution; not an isolated ALU/LUT comparison.
